0022600200.text: The Celtics (6-2, 2nd in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back) visit the Bucks (1-7, 5th in the Central, 5 games back) with Boston on a one-game win streak and a 1-2 road record, while Milwaukee has lost four straight and is 1-7 over its last ten. The Celtics lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 109-102 win in Boston on November 4, 2026, and they also won the 2025-26 series 3-1. Both teams have another game to play before this one.
